items.title: Louis Armstrong: Jazz Casual Interview, 1964-07-10
items.q: Used to play with Mamie Smith.

ctx.x: All right. Yeah. With singers like Ma Rainey, did they ever appear in the places where you played with Oliver? Oh, well, not at the Lincoln Gardens.

They didn't. I mean, they're always in the theaters, and the crowd's standing around the corner to get in. Yeah. Like Bessie Smith, Mamie Smith, and Clara Smith, and Miss Barnes, what is her name? She was in, no, she made this good time flat blues. All that. Yeah. Yeah. Well, they always had their own band, like Coleman Hawkins. Used to play with Mamie Smith.
Well, when they started to make these records, and you made a whole series of records accompanying singers, how did they bring you in? Did they heard you?
